title: Travel Booking SEO: 931K Clicks, 66M Impressions
excerpt: Technical and on-page SEO for a hotel booking website, tracked in Google Search Console over 16 months.
content:
The client

A hotel booking website with thousands of hotel and destination pages competing against the biggest travel brands in Google. The client name and domain are hidden for privacy; every number comes from Google Search Console.

The challenge

Large travel sites lose traffic to crawl waste, duplicate destination pages and weak titles. The goal was to grow clicks from existing rankings and push key pages higher.

What I did

  • Technical audit of crawling, indexing and duplicate pages
  • Title and meta description rewrites to lift click-through rate
  • Heading structure and internal links between destination and hotel pages
  • Structured data so listings can earn rich results
  • Weekly tracking in Google Search Console

Results

  • 931K clicks and 66M impressions over 16 months
  • Clicks up 16% in the last six months against the six before
  • Average CTR improved from 1.3% to 1.7%
  • Average position improved from 14.8 to 13.2

Want results like these? Every project starts with a free audit, so you see exactly what is holding your site back before you spend anything.
